en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large multi‑span steel truss bridge crossing a wide river. In the foreground there is a steam-powered riverboat docked at a landing with several people standing on the pier. The bridge has prominent latticework arches and stone piers, and a tall metal signal or lighting structure rises above one of the spans. At the top of the image is the printed caption "Riesa a. Elbe" indicating the location.
